name: SettingRow
description:
One setting on one line: label (with an optional value and badge) and description on
the left, the control right-aligned. When the row is too narrow, the control drops
below the text instead of squeezing it (container query). Booleans are switches in
setting rows (R15.4).
signature: ({ label, description, value, badge, control, status, error, disabled, className, ...rest }: SettingRowProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: control
props.description: The control or action, right-aligned: Switch, Segmented, a secondary Button.

props.name: description
props.description: What the setting does, when the label alone does not say it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: error
props.description: Error text in place of the description while `status` is "error".

props.name: label
props.description: Names the setting ("Keep agent up to date"). It labels the control.

props.name: status
props.description:
In-place save feedback for settings that apply immediately (R15.11): a spinner while
saving, a drawn ✓ on success, ✕ on failure. It sits beside the control and never
moves it. Drive it with `useActionFeedback()` from Button.

props.name: value
props.description: A read-only current value shown beside the label ("SuperGrok", "1979").

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
